subject: science
title: Parts of a Plant
about: The parts of a plant and the job each does: roots take in water and hold the plant, the stem carries water and holds it up, leaves use sunlight to make food, flowers make seeds and seeds grow into new plants, plus what a seed needs to sprout. Plant parts are not named in NC's 2023 Grade 1 standards; this bridge deck sits under LS.1.1.1 because each part meets one of the needs that objective lists (water, air, light).
tip: Pull up a weed together, roots and all, and name each part from the bottom up.

cards.q: Which part of a plant grows down into the soil?
cards.note: Roots are under the ground, so you usually cannot see them.

cards.q: What do roots take in from the soil?
cards.note: Roots also take in nutrients from the soil.

cards.q: The wind blows hard, but the plant stays put. What holds it in the ground?
cards.note: Roots spread out in the soil like an anchor.

cards.q: What holds a flower up tall so it can reach the light?
cards.note: A sunflower stem can grow taller than a grown-up.

cards.q: Water travels from the roots up to the leaves. What does it travel through?
cards.note: A stem is like a straw for the plant.

cards.q: What do we call the thick, woody stem of a tree?
cards.note: A trunk holds up all the branches and carries water to every leaf.

cards.q: Which part uses sunlight to make food for the plant?
cards.note: Leaves use sunlight, air and water to make the plant's food.

cards.q: Where do most leaves grow, down in the soil or up in the light?
cards.note: Leaves need light, so they grow where the light is.

cards.q: Which part of a plant makes the seeds?
cards.note: After the petals drop, seeds grow where the flower was.

cards.q: What are the colorful parts of a flower called?
cards.note: Bright petals help bees and butterflies find the flower.

cards.q: A bee visits a flower. What is the bee looking for?
cards.note: The bee carries pollen from flower to flower. That helps flowers make seeds.

cards.q: An apple has seeds inside. What part of the plant is an apple?
cards.note: A fruit grows from a flower and holds the seeds.

cards.q: What grows out of a seed?
cards.note: A tiny seed can grow into a huge tree.

cards.q: A seed sprouts. What pokes out first and grows down?
cards.note: The root comes first. Then a shoot grows up toward the light.

cards.q: A seed needs water to sprout. What else does it need?
cards.note: Most seeds also need air. They do not need light until they poke up.

cards.q: A carrot grows under the ground. Is it a root, a leaf or a flower?
cards.note: We eat roots like carrots, leaves like lettuce and seeds like peas.

cards.q: Lettuce is the flat green part of a plant. Is it a leaf, a root or a seed?
cards.note: Spinach and cabbage are leaves we eat too.
